W: 你今晚打算做什么？我在想我们能不能去Charles Street那家新餐厅试试
M: 抱歉，我这个周末要回家给我弟弟过18岁生日
M: 我所有的亲戚都会来
W: 是啊，我也很想见她
W: 听起来很诱人。但我要到5点才能准备好
M: 嗯，我本来打算马上就走
W: 但这会不会太麻烦你了？
M: 不，完全不会。我先去车站

items.stem: What is the probable reason the bear walks upright on its back legs?

choices.text: It tries to entertain its audience.
It tries to look into the distance.
It wants to catch people's attention.
choices.zh: 它想要吸引人们的注意。

choices.text: It has got one of its limbs injured.

items.stem: How is the bear first known to the public?

choices.text: It was spotted by animal protection officials.
choices.zh: 它被动物保护官员发现了。

choices.text: It was filmed by a local television reporter.
choices.zh: 它被当地电视台记者拍摄了。

choices.text: Its videos were posted on social media.
choices.zh: 它的视频被发布在社交媒体上。

choices.text: Its picture won a photography prize.
choices.zh: 它的照片赢得了摄影奖。

items.stem: What new record did the American drivers set last year?

choices.text: The distance travelled.
The incidence of road accidents.
The spending on gas.
The number of people travelling.

items.stem: What is depressing according to the speaker?

choices.text: Fewer people are commuting.
Gas consumption is soaring.
Job growth is slowing down.
Rush-hour traffic is worsening.
choices.zh: 高峰时段交通状况恶化。

items.stem: What did teenager Chauncy do at the grocery store to get some food?

choices.text: He told a stranger the sad story about himself.
choices.zh: 他向一个陌生人讲述了自己的悲惨故事。

choices.text: He helped a stranger to carry groceries to his car.
choices.zh: 他帮助一个陌生人把杂货搬到他的车上。

choices.text: He went up to a stranger and pulled at his sleeves.
choices.zh: 他走向一个陌生人并拉扯他的袖子。

choices.text: He washed a stranger's car in return for some food.
choices.zh: 他给一个陌生人洗车以换取一些食物。

items.stem: What did the stranger do for Chauncy?

choices.text: He ordered a lot of food for his family.
choices.zh: 他为Chauncy的家人订购了很多食物。

choices.text: He gave him a job at his own company.
choices.zh: 他在自己的公司给了Chauncy一份工作。

choices.text: He raised a large sum of money for him.
He offered him a scholarship for college.
choices.zh: 他为Chauncy提供了大学奖学金。

items.stem: What do we learn about Chauncy?

choices.text: He works hard to support his family.
He is an excellent student at school.
choices.zh: 他在学校是一名优秀的学生。

choices.text: He is very good at making up stories.
He has been disabled since boyhood.
choices.zh: 他从童年起就一直是残疾人。

items.stem: What has the man just done?

choices.text: Attended an economics lecture.
choices.zh: 参加了一场经济学讲座。

choices.text: Taken a walk on Charles Street.
Had a drink at Queen Victoria.
Had dinner at a new restaurant.
choices.zh: 在一家新餐厅吃了晚饭。

items.stem: What is the man going to do this weekend?

choices.text: Treat a college friend to dinner.
choices.zh: 请一位大学朋友吃晚饭。

choices.text: Make preparations for a seminar.
Attend his brother's birthday party.
choices.zh: 参加他哥哥的生日聚会。

choices.text: Visit some of his high school friends.
choices.zh: 拜访他的一些高中朋友。

items.stem: What does the man ask the woman to do?

choices.text: Gather statistics for his lecture.
choices.zh: 为他的讲座收集统计数据。

choices.text: Throw a surprise birthday party.
choices.zh: 举办一个惊喜生日派对。

choices.text: Meet with Jonathan's friends on the weekend.
Join him in his brother's birthday celebration.
choices.zh: 加入他哥哥的生日庆祝活动。

items.stem: How would they go to the man's home?

choices.text: By car.
By train.
By taxi.
By bus.

items.stem: What does the man think of doing?

choices.text: Taking a vacation abroad.
Reviewing for his last exam.
choices.zh: 为他的最后一场考试复习。

choices.text: Saving enough money for a rainy day.
choices.zh: 存足够的钱以备不时之需。

choices.text: Finding a better way to earn money.
choices.zh: 找一个更好的赚钱方式。

items.stem: What has the man been doing for the past few months?

choices.text: Preparing for his final exams.
Negotiating with his boss for a raise.
Working part time as a waiter.
Helping the woman with her courses.

items.stem: What does the woman say she needs to do before departure?

choices.text: Finish her term paper.
Save enough money.
Learn a little bit of Spanish.
Ask her parents' permission.

items.stem: Why does the woman want to invite Tom?

choices.text: He has rich sailing experience.
He speaks Spanish fluently.
choices.zh: 他西班牙语说得很流利。

choices.text: He is also eager to go to Spain.
He is easy to get along with.

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Marie Curie's daughter?

choices.text: She went to the same university as her mother.
choices.zh: 她上了和她母亲同一所大学。

choices.text: She worked as a nurse in the First World War.
choices.zh: 她在第一次世界大战中担任护士。

choices.text: She won the Nobel Prize two times.
She was also a Nobel Prize winner.
choices.zh: 她也是诺贝尔奖获得者。

items.stem: For what was Irene Curie awarded a Military Medal?

choices.text: She fought bravely in a series of military operations.
choices.zh: 她在一系列军事行动中英勇作战。

choices.text: She developed X-ray facilities for military hospitals.
choices.zh: 她为军队医院开发了X射线设施。

choices.text: She helped to set up several military hospitals.
choices.zh: 她帮助建立了几所军队医院。

choices.text: She made donations to save wounded soldiers.

items.stem: In what way were Marie and Irene similar?

choices.text: Both died of blood cancer.
Both fought in World War I.
choices.zh: 两人都参加了第一次世界大战。

choices.text: Both won military medals.
choices.zh: 两人都获得了军功勋章。

choices.text: Both married their assistants.
choices.zh: 两人都嫁给了自己的助手。

items.stem: What do we learn about the Vikings?

choices.text: They were the first settlers in Europe.
choices.zh: 他们是欧洲最早的定居者。

choices.text: They were the conquerors of Norway.
They discovered Iceland in the ninth century.
choices.zh: 他们在九世纪发现了冰岛。

choices.text: They settled on a small island north of England.
choices.zh: 他们在英格兰北部的一个小岛上定居。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Greenland?

choices.text: It was some five hundred miles west of Norway.
choices.zh: 它位于挪威以西约五百英里处。

choices.text: It was covered with green most time of the year.
choices.zh: 它一年中大部分时间都覆盖着绿色植被。

choices.text: It was the Vikings' most important discovery.
choices.zh: 它是维京人最重要的发现。

choices.text: It was a rocky mass of land covered with ice.
choices.zh: 它是一片覆盖着冰的岩石陆地。

items.stem: What does the speaker mainly talk about?

choices.text: The Vikings' ocean explorations.
The making of European nations.
The Vikings' everyday life.
The Europeans' Arctic discoveries.

items.stem: What does the speaker think everyone tends to do?

choices.text: Work hard for a better life.
choices.zh: 为了更好的生活而努力工作。

choices.text: Make mistakes now and then.
Dream about the future.
Save against a rainy day.

items.stem: What does the speaker say he would refuse to do?

choices.text: Teach foreign languages for the rest of his life.
Change what he has for his past imaginary world.
choices.zh: 用他所拥有的换取他过去想象的世界。

choices.text: Exchange his two-story house for a beach cottage.
choices.zh: 用他的两层楼房换取海滨小屋。

choices.text: Dwell on the dreams he had dreamed when young.
choices.zh: 沉湎于他年轻时做过的梦。

items.stem: What did the speaker major in during the first two years of college?

choices.text: Criminal law.
City planning.
Oriental architecture.
International business.

items.stem: What is one of the biggest lessons the speaker has learned in life?

choices.text: Dream and make plans.
Take things easy in life.
Be content with what you have.
Enjoy whatever you are doing.
choices.zh: 享受你正在做的任何事情。
